top_signals.title: Texas Senate Race Will Come Down to Turnout, Says Siena's Levy
top_signals.summary: Don Levy, director of the Siena Research Institute, said that while the Democratic party itself is not gaining in popularity, 'change' is what's on top of mind for voters, and 'they want their lives to be better' and see voting as a way to do that. Levy also discussed the fight for Latino voters in Texas and other sunbelt states and said that many voters believe that ICE tactics go too far.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Charlie Cunnion Names as Massport New Port Director
top_signals.summary: The Massachusetts Port Authority (Massport) announced the appointment of Charlie Cunnion as Port Director. Cunnion brings over 25 years of leadership experience across global transportation, supply chain management, operations, organizational transformation, and strategic planning.
